recognize_zh: 這是兩組 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線（非形態學影像），顯示濾泡性淋巴瘤自體移植後的整體存活依先前治療線數分層：先前治療越少（1 線或 2 線）存活越好，3 線以上者存活明顯較差。
features: Panel A: survival probability over 14 years by 1 regimen, 2 regimens, and 3 or more prior regimens
Panel A: 3 or more regimens curve drops to about 40% by 5 years, versus about 60% for 1 regimen at 7-8 years
Panel B: survival (%) over 20 years for 2 therapies (n=44), 3 therapies (n=35), and more than 3 therapies (n=42)
Panel B: long-term survival about 55-65% with 2 therapies, about 45% with 3, and about 25% with more than 3
Censoring tick marks and stepwise curves typical of Kaplan-Meier analysis
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure presents two Kaplan-Meier analyses of overall survival after autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for follicular lymphoma, stratified by the number of prior treatment regimens. In both cohorts, survival decreases progressively with more prior lines of therapy: patients transplanted after one or two regimens have substantially better long-term survival than those receiving three or more regimens. The interpretation is that autologous transplantation is most effective when used earlier in the disease course, before the development of chemoresistance.
